beats.label: hook
beats.text: From the team that built Halo and Destiny — every weapon you carry out of the zone stays with you next run. Die and lose everything you brought in.

beats.label: gameplay
beats.text: You're a bio-cybernetic Runner on Tau Ceti IV. Drop into a hostile zone solo or with a squad. Scavenge gear, fight AI enemies and rival player squads, then race to extract. Everything you pull out carries forward. Everything you had when you died is gone.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: Bungie's risk/reward persistence system makes every run a calculated bet — a well-equipped Runner who's been extracting for weeks has a real edge. Full cross-play and cross-save across PC, PS5, and Xbox.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Marathon is out now on Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S — $39.99.
